title: Final answer (1)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for tanα, specifically μg/(ω₁²r₁).

title: Force balance for (1)
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law radially (Tcosα = mω₁²r₁) and balance friction tangentially (Tsinα = μmg).

title: Tension decomposition for (2)
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly resolve the rope tension T' into horizontal (T'sinθ) and vertical (T'cosθ) components relative to the vertical.

title: 3D force analysis for (2)
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly project the horizontal tension component (T'sinθ) along and perpendicular to the radial direction O₁B using angle β.

title: Vertical force equilibrium
description: Important Criteria: The solution must establish the vertical force balance: Normal force + vertical tension = mg (i.e., Fₙ + T'cosθ = mg).

title: Final answer (2)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct final expression for ω₂: √[ (μg sinθ cosβ) / ((sinθ sinβ + μ cosθ) r₂) ].

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the friction force in part (2) is incorrectly aligned (e.g., set opposite to the T₁sinβ component).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Award points if the student explicitly checks or notes the dimensional consistency of their final expressions.
